competitor_landscape_summary.market_positioning: Mid-tier domain authority in a competitive market. West Herr dominates the region with 62 DA. Basil Ford's two-location setup (Cheektowaga + Niagara Falls) is an advantage over single-location competitors, but the website has significant content gaps vs. all competitors.
content_gaps_vs_competitors_observed: No trade-in appraisal tool (West Herr has one on every page)
No service coupon or specials page (Queenston and West Herr both have prominent specials)
No dedicated EV landing page (Niagara Frontier Ford has a Mach-E page)
No commercial/fleet section (West Herr and Ford both need this for Transit/E-Transit buyers)
No buy-online or reserve-vehicle tool (West Herr has this)
No blog or educational content (none of the competitors have this either — potential differentiator)
No video walkarounds or virtual tours
